description: Write a press release and distribute it over a newswire to get press coverage. PRICE: tier "wire" = $99 USDC (500+ news sites plus 100+ TV and radio network sites); tier "premium" = $299 USDC (everything in wire plus AP News, USA Today, Barchart, StreetInsider). Use when the user says things like "get press coverage", "write and distribute a press release", "send a press release to news sites", "put out a press release on the wire", "PR distribution". Drafts a 450-600 word AP-style release from the product URL (or, if the user already wrote the release, pass it as headline + body and it is sent as written after the service's safety checks); it goes through editorial review and is distributed, usually same day on weekdays. Returns an order_id; poll get_release_status for live links. Not accepted: crypto token sales, gambling, adult, health/cure claims, cannabis, and market-moving news (acquisitions, earnings, IPOs, stock, FDA, lawsuits). Charges REAL USDC on Base mainnet from the user's own wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY) via x402. Two steps: call first WITHOUT confirm_token (or with quote_only=true) to get the price and a confirm_token; show the user the exact price and get explicit approval; then call again with identical parameters and that confirm_token (single use, expires in 10 minutes). It only pays if the price is <= MAX_SPEND_USD, the lifetime total stays <= MAX_TOTAL_SPEND_USD, and the server's payment terms match the pinned Agent Press Wire wallet and price; otherwise it returns the quote without paying. The service only settles payment if the job succeeds.

announcement.description: What is being announced (launch, new version, feature, funding, milestone). Strongly recommended: without it only news visible on the page is written about, and the call fails uncharged if there is none.

body.description: Bring your own copy (optional, together with headline): the finished release text in English, plain text, paragraphs separated by blank lines, 150 to 900 words (380 to 900 for wire tiers), at most 5 links and only to the product's own site. Omit headline and body to have the release drafted from the page.

city.description: City of the announcing company (newswire dateline).

confirm_token.description: confirm_token from a previous quote of this tool with the exact same parameters, passed only after the user approved the quoted price. Without it the call only quotes.

contact_email.description: Media contact email printed on the release (required by newswires).

headline.description: Bring your own copy (optional, together with body): the finished headline, 3 to 20 words, naming the announcing company. When headline and body are given the service publishes or distributes the text as written instead of drafting; it still runs the same safety checks (prohibited topics, market-moving claims on wire tiers, links only to the product's own site, brand must match the page, model safety review) and fails uncharged with reasons if they do not pass.

product_url.description: Public URL of the product, launch page, or repo being announced.

quote_only.description: If true, never pay: just return the x402 price quote and a confirm_token. Use this first to show the user the price.

tier.description: "wire" = $99 (500+ news sites); "premium" = $299 (adds AP News, USA Today, Barchart, StreetInsider).

name: distribute_press_release
title: Write and distribute a press release over a newswire ($99 / $299)
